Why the Popular Advice Is Wrong

The popular advice to use traditional payment gateways or platforms is misguided, as it ignores the very real restrictions and limitations faced by creators in Ghana and other countries. These platforms often require KYC verification, charge exorbitant fees, and can freeze or shut down accounts without notice. In contrast, blockchain-based payments offer a decentralized, permissionless, and censorship-resistant alternative that can be used by anyone, anywhere in the world.
What the Architecture and Experience Actually Show

My experience deploying sovereign digital commerce stacks for creators has shown that blockchain-based payments, such as USDT on Tron, can settle in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This is a game-changer for creators who need to receive payments quickly and reliably. Additionally, platforms like Binance P2P support local currencies like naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, making it easier for creators to receive payments in their local currency.

By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from this dependency and take control of their earnings and customer data. This is not just a matter of convenience; it's a matter of financial security and independence.
